sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_datasets (
  dataset_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  version     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  write_token TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journals (
  dataset_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
  id          TEXT NOT NULL,
  open_date   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  stock_code  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  stock_name  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  status      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted',
  snapshot_id TEXT,
  record_id   TEXT,
  payload     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_journals_dataset_open_date ON journals (dataset_id, open_date, id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_snapshots (
  dataset_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
  snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  version     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  stages      TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, snapshot_id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_watchlist (
  dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  position   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name       TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, position)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_snapshot_meta (
  dataset_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  version     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  write_token TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journal_watchlist_meta (
  dataset_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  version     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  write_token TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS record_meta (
  dataset_id               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  version                  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  write_token              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  custom_monthly_use       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cycle_stats_generated_at INTEGER,
  updated_at               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records (
  dataset_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
  id                TEXT NOT NULL,
  open_date         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  stock_code        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  stock_name        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  trading_type      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  pre_market        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  has_mistake       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  profit_percent    REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  hold_days         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  position_size     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  has_cycle_stats   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  has_monthly_stats INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cycle_id          TEXT,
  image_prefix      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  remark            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  payload           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  updated_at        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_records_dataset_open_date ON records (dataset_id, open_date DESC, id DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS custom_analysis (
  dataset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  use_custom INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  payload    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS monthly_analysis (
  dataset_id                       TEXT NOT NULL,
  month                            TEXT NOT NULL,
  system_profit_ratio              REAL,
  system_no_mistake_profit_ratio   REAL,
  system_with_mistake_profit_ratio REAL,
  non_system_profit_ratio          REAL,
  avg_profit_ratio                 REAL,
  total_profit                     REAL,
  PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, month)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cycle_stats (
  dataset_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
  stat_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
  cycle_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
  start_date   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  end_date     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  record_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  is_complete  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  profit_sum   REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  loss_sum     REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  profit_ratio REAL,
  record_ids   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, stat_type, cycle_id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stat_overview (
  dataset_id                       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  record_count                     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  profit_count                     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  loss_count                       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  flat_count                       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  system_profit_ratio              REAL,
  system_no_mistake_profit_ratio   REAL,
  system_with_mistake_profit_ratio REAL,
  non_system_profit_ratio          REAL,
  system_profit_avg_hold_days      REAL,
  system_loss_avg_hold_days        REAL,
  non_system_profit_avg_hold_days  REAL,
  non_system_loss_avg_hold_days    REAL,
  trading_type_ratios              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  trend_feature_ratios             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  aggregate_ratios                 TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  theoretical_profit_ratios        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  source_version                   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  computed_at                      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stat_month (
  dataset_id                       TEXT NOT NULL,
  month                            TEXT NOT NULL,
  system_profit_ratio              REAL,
  system_no_mistake_profit_ratio   REAL,
  system_with_mistake_profit_ratio REAL,
  non_system_profit_ratio          REAL,
  avg_profit_ratio                 REAL,
  total_profit                     REAL,
  source_version                   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  computed_at                      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, month)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS analysis_results (
  dataset_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_kind    TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
  record_count   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  values_json    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  positions_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  cumulative     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  cycle          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  growth         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  skewness       REAL,
  kurtosis       REAL,
  jb             REAL,
  jb_p_value     REAL,
  source_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  computed_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, config_kind, config_id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_analysis_results_kind ON analysis_results (dataset_id, config_kind)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS field_configs (
  dataset_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  version     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  write_token TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  payload     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS series_meta (
  dataset_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL,
  version     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  write_token TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, kind)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS analysis_series (
  dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tab',
  id         TEXT NOT NULL,
  name       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  position   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, kind, id)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS analysis_series_groups (
  dataset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tab',
  series_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
  seq        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  mode       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'merge',
  source     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'profitPercent',
  filter     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  PRIMARY KEY (dataset_id, kind, series_id, seq)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datasets (
  id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name       TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  deleted_at TEXT
)
